description: This file defines a utility enum 'KeychainStore' providing static methods to load, save, and delete string data in the keychain, acting as a wrapper around 'GenericPasswordKeychainStore'.

methods.name: loadString
methods.description: Loads a string value from the keychain for a given service and account.

methods.name: saveString
methods.description: Saves a string value to the keychain for a given service and account.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a keychain item for the given service and account.
